messages.text: I’m reviewing the committed staggered barrel implementation, focusing on slab boundaries, PCB/service clearances, cooling and frame ownership, and whether the reported coverage follows the actual geometry.

The staggered slabs retain the envelope, and their shorter end families preserve the3 mm PCB-to-bay clearance. The committed controls pass. I’m now checking transformed component bounds and cooling-hole containment independently; the headers and cable routes remain explicitly absent.

**BARREL-SysArch-implementation reviewed `3d95e0b4485783fd3f62712527adc5b49869d277`. No blocking packing or material-ownership defect found within the isolated prototype.** I supplied the earlier centred proposal; this review independently checked the coordinator’s staggered implementation.

The−96/+96 mm phases produce276/468 mm end slabs with2/4 board rows, preserving69 rows overall,±3880 mm panel bounds and2 mm panel gaps. All transformed board components fit; minimum PCB side clearance is **1.440 mm**, board-to-bay clearance **3 mm**, and coolant-hole clearance to copper **0.5 mm**. Slab frames correctly exclude skin/cold-plate material. Tungsten remains owned once per layer/sector. [Pinned layout](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/3d95e0b4485783fd3f62712527adc5b49869d277/tools/calorimeter_hardware/barrel_layout.py), [hardware ownership and cooling](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/3d95e0b4485783fd3f62712527adc5b49869d277/tools/calorimeter_hardware/barrel_export.py#L41).

Independent checks actually run:

- All **8 committed barrel controls passed**, executed from Git blobs without substituting working-tree source.
- Checked22494 logical board placements,539856 transformed component bounds,2934 coolant cutters and3366 interface boxes.
-77 direct ray/plane calculations agreed with the coverage algorithm.
- Read the coordinator’s generated native artifact and verified16 source hashes plus compact, expected-inventory, validator, factory and segmentation bindings.
- All **60 native rays agreed with independent finite-thickness silicon intersections**. Five differed from centre-plane predictions by1–2 layers; each is explained by the0.5 mm silicon thickness. No unexplained discrepancy remains.

The native artifact reports zero overlaps at1e−5 mm,359904 sensor-ID round trips and **299.002915 t**, matching the independent inventory calculation. I did **not** execute ROOT/native jobs. Artifact SHA256: `9f349b7139c3bc6066ff4cee52e50afc92a5d1410d54c3c3157d7f5374733c7e`.

The important remaining interfaces are explicit limitations:

- **CaloTech↔shared services:**46944 modeled tube runs terminate inside copper with5 mm setbacks. Headers, ports and connections are absent; up to93888 branch endpoints need a service architecture. The188.40 kW/9.01 kg/s figures are hypotheses, not demonstrated cooling.
- **CaloTech↔SysArch:** side/end reservations contain tungsten or aluminium. Radial collectors require ports or an external route.299 t of barrel mass needs a support/load assessment; retained rails are not mechanical qualification.
- **Barrel↔endcap:** the3920 mm flange end leaves30 mm to the3950 mm endcap front. Connector installation and shared-service handoff are unverified.
- **Coverage:** staggering removes the aligned control’s eta0.25 blind band; atφ0.03 it now crosses31 layers. The sector-centre eta0 crack remains **22/48 layers**. This supports a geometric improvement, not calorimetric acceptance. [Recorded limitations](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/3d95e0b4485783fd3f62712527adc5b49869d277/docs/design/DES-031-siw-barrel-prototype.md).

The native validator stores rays without itself enforcing plane/finite-thickness agreement; retain this independent comparison in the validation record before claiming that agreement. [Validator ray loop](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/3d95e0b4485783fd3f62712527adc5b49869d277/tools/calorimeter_hardware/barrel_native.py#L138).
